Remark
[the Ricci identity as a derivation]

Source: petersen:page-0097 ↗ lem:pet-ch3-curvature-tensor-tensorial

The symmetry of the Hessian implies that $R_{X,Y}$ annihilates functions. Thus $ abla ^2_{X,Y}- abla ^2_{Y,X}=R_{X,Y}=R(X,Y)$, where on the right $R(X,Y)$ is regarded as a $(1,1)$-tensor acting on tensors as a derivation. In particular, if $T$ is a $(0,k)$-tensor, \[ (R_{X,Y}T)(X_1,\dots ,X_k)=-T(R(X,Y)X_1,\dots ,X_k)-\dots -T(X_1,\dots ,R(X,Y)X_k). \]
